profile.name: LoopPlayer x Apple Music (iOS 26) design profile
profile.target: iPhone, dark mode only for now (tested on iPhone 13, 390 x 844 pt)
profile.framework: Flutter, Material 3 theme, NO new packages
profile.fidelity: INSPIRED BY Apple Music, not a pixel copy. Only restyle screens and features LoopPlayer already has.
profile.measurements_note: All sizes are in Flutter logical points (same as iOS pt). They were estimated by eye from the owner's screenshots (screenshot px / 3), so treat them as close, not exact. Colors are approximations too.
source_screenshots: Home: huge bold title, horizontal carousels with rounded artwork, pure black background
Home with floating glass bottom bar: tab-bar pill + round search button, and above it a floating glass mini-player pill

Now Playing (paused): artwork-tinted dark background, grabber at top, smaller centered artwork, title/artist left, round star and ellipsis buttons right, thin progress bar, big bare white transport glyphs, small icon row at the bottom
Queue: small artwork + title on top, a row of pill buttons, 'Continue Playing' list with 48 pt artwork rows, progress and transport kept below
Lock screen: system-owned Now Playing widget (NOT styleable; it only shows what the app sends through audio_service)

how_to_use_this_file: UI work only. Do not change playback, loop engine, database or provider logic.
Work in the small steps listed in implementation_order; after each step the owner runs the app and reports back.
Read the current files before changing them. File names below come from STATUS.md; confirm them in the project.
Prefer one shared theme file and a few shared widgets (glass container, circle button, song row) over styling every screen separately.
Do not over-engineer: follow the 'must' list first, 'nice' only if cheap, never build the 'skip' list.
hard_rules: Keep every existing behavior: tap/long-press on the Loop button, Next always wins, queue, favorites, playlists, import, search, remove with confirmation.

Keep existing widget Keys and visible button texts that tests use (e.g. loop_save_button, loop_cancel_button, loop_start_field, loop_end_field, loop_preview_button, loop_start_plus, 'Preview', 'Infinite'). Run flutter test after every step (owner last reported 162 passing) and fix tests only when a purely visual change broke them.
Do not put a Tooltip around the Loop button (its long-press competes with ours).
Do not add or remove packages without asking the owner. Use flutter/services HapticFeedback and dart:ui BackdropFilter, which need no package.
Use song.absoluteArtworkPath / song.absoluteFilePath for files, never raw stored paths.
Riverpod 3: use .when(...) on AsyncValue. Watch providers, never the raw player.
BackdropFilter is expensive: use it only on the mini player, bottom sheets and a few small buttons, never on every list row.
design_principles: Content first: artwork and song titles are the stars; chrome is quiet, translucent and dark.
One accent color (Apple Music red/pink) used sparingly: active states, primary buttons, current song, favorites.
Big bold titles, generous spacing, rounded everything (continuous-corner feel).
Glass (blur + translucent fill + hairline highlight) for floating things: mini player, round icon buttons, sheets.
The loop features are LoopPlayer's identity: keep them visible but styled as native-looking Apple controls.

color.separator: #38383A  (0.5 pt hairlines, inset from the text start in lists)
color.accent: #FA2D48  (Apple Music red/pink, approximate; define once as the ColorScheme primary)

typography.font: Platform default (San Francisco on iOS). Do NOT bundle a font.
typography.large_title: 34 pt, bold, letter-spacing -0.4 (screen titles like Library)
typography.caption: 12 pt, semibold, text_secondary (times, counts)

glass_recipe.what: Approximation of iOS 26 Liquid Glass. Flutter has no native version.
glass_recipe.build: ClipRRect(radius) -> BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX 24, sigmaY 24)) -> DecoratedBox(color glass_fill, border 0.5 pt glass_border) -> content
glass_recipe.tip: Make ONE reusable GlassContainer widget and reuse it. Add a very faint top-to-bottom white highlight gradient (0.10 -> 0.02) for depth.

motion.curve: Curves.easeOutCubic (or a spring-like easeOutBack only for the artwork scale)

haptics.note: Optional and tiny; skip if it complicates tests.

components.GlassContainer: Reusable blur + translucent fill + hairline border wrapper (see glass_recipe). Used by the mini player, circle buttons and the loop status capsule.
components.CircleIconButton: 44 pt glass circle, 22 pt icon, white. Used for heart, queue, +/- nudge buttons, Loop button. Active state: fill glass_fill_strong, icon accent.
components.PillChipRow: Horizontally scrolling row of pill chips, 34 pt tall, 16 pt horizontal padding, 8 pt gap, 17 pt semibold. Selected = chip_selected + black text; unselected = chip_unselected + white text.
components.SongRow: 64 pt row. Leading 48 pt artwork (radius 6). Title 17 medium, subtitle 15 secondary. Trailing: duration (15 secondary), small heart (tertiary when off, favorite_on when on), '...' menu. Hairline separator inset 76. Current song: title in accent and a dim overlay with an animated/graphic_eq icon on the artwork.
components.ArtworkWidget: Keep the existing widget. Fallback when there is no artwork: rounded square with a subtle gradient (#3A3A3C -> #1C1C1E) and a centered music-note icon in tertiary color.
components.SectionHeader: 22 pt bold, 20 pt side margin, 28 pt above.
components.PrimaryButton: Filled accent, white 17 semibold label, stadium shape, 50 pt tall (44 minimum).
components.SecondaryButton: Filled glass or tonal (white 12%), white label, stadium shape.
components.ProgressBar: 6 pt tall rounded track, played part progress_played, remaining progress_track. Thumb hidden normally; while dragging the bar grows to ~10 pt. Times in caption style below the bar, left = elapsed, right = total duration (PRD FR-007 asks for total; showing -remaining is optional).
components.EmptyState: 64 pt icon in tertiary, 20 pt bold title, secondary body text, one accent PrimaryButton (e.g. 'Import music').
components.Dialogs: Rounded 14, dark surface_raised background, bold title, secondary body, destructive action in destructive color. Keep all existing confirmations.

library.header: Large title 'Library' (34 pt bold) on a transparent flat app bar. Trailing: 44 pt glass circle with '+' in accent (import). Use SliverAppBar.large or a plain padded Text; keep it simple.
library.search: Under the title: 40 pt pill-ish field (radius 12), fill white 12%, magnifier icon, hint text as today. Keep the shared search provider behavior.
library.sections: Replace the top TabBar look with a PillChipRow containing the existing sections (Songs, Albums, Artists, Playlists, Favorites, Recently Played). Keep the same swipe/page behavior (TabBarView or PageView) and the same data/providers. If a restyled TabBar is easier, give it isScrollable: true, a pill indicator and no divider.
library.lists: Songs, favorites, recents and album/artist/playlist detail lists use SongRow. Album and artist lists use a 56 pt row with 48 pt artwork (radius 6) or a circle for artists, name 17 medium, subtitle '12 songs' 15 secondary, chevron in tertiary.
library.bottom: List needs extra bottom padding (mini player height + 24) so the last row is not hidden behind the floating mini player. Use extendBody: true so lists scroll under the glass.

detail_screens.layout: Centered 200 pt artwork (radius 12, soft shadow; for artists use the first song's artwork or a circle), 22 pt bold name, 15 secondary subtitle, then two pill buttons side by side: 'Play all' (accent PrimaryButton style) and the existing menu as a secondary pill/circle. Then the SongRow list. Mini player floats at the bottom.
detail_screens.keep: Rename / Delete playlist and 'Remove from playlist' behavior exactly as today.

mini_player.style: Floating GlassContainer pill: 12 pt side margins, 8 pt above the bottom safe area, 60 pt tall, radius 30. Left: 40 pt artwork (radius 8), then title 15 semibold and artist 13 secondary (1 line each). Right: play/pause glyph 28 pt and next glyph 26 pt, bare white icons (no filled circle), 44 pt touch targets.
mini_player.progress: The thin progress line at the top may be removed (Apple's has none) or kept very subtle at the pill's bottom edge.
mini_player.tap: Tap on artwork/title opens Now Playing as today.

now_playing.background: Full-screen vertical gradient from a dark tint of the artwork color to a darker version of it (see dynamic_artwork_background). Fallback: now_playing_fallback_gradient.
now_playing.top: Small grabber pill (36 x 5, white 35%) centered near the top. Remove the 'Now Playing' app-bar title. Keep a way to close: keep the down-chevron or support swipe-down; the grabber alone must not remove the existing close behavior.
now_playing.artwork: Centered, square, size = min(screen width - 48, 340) while playing; animated to 0.86x of that when paused (AnimatedScale, 300 ms). Radius 14, soft shadow.
now_playing.title_row: Left: title 22 bold (max 2 lines), artist 18 secondary. Right: 44 pt glass circle with the existing heart (red when favorite).
now_playing.seek_bar: ProgressBar component (existing seek logic unchanged: drag shows finger position, seek on release).
now_playing.transport: Three bare white glyphs, evenly spaced with ~56 pt gaps: previous (fast_rewind_rounded look, 44 pt), play/pause (60 pt, NO filled circle; keep the loading spinner state), next (fast_forward_rounded look, 44 pt). Same handlers and tooltips as today.
now_playing.loop_status: The existing LoopStatusPanel becomes a compact GlassContainer capsule (radius 20, ~48 pt tall) under the transport, only when a section loop exists: left 'A-B  1:05 - 1:20', middle 'Waiting - starts at 1:05' / 'Running - 3 left' / 'Running - infinity' in secondary text (accent for Running), right a small 'Edit loop' pill. Keep all the existing texts and states.
now_playing.bottom_row: Row of 44 pt glass circles near the bottom safe area: Loop button on the left (same widget, same tap/long-press; off = secondary icon, active = glass_fill_strong with accent icon and the existing badge: 1 / infinity / A-B), Queue button on the right (opens QueueScreen). Center stays empty.
now_playing.do_not_add: No volume slider, lyrics, AirPlay or shuffle (the app has none of these).

queue.background: Same artwork-tinted gradient as Now Playing for continuity.
queue.header: 56 pt artwork (radius 8) + current title (17 bold) + artist (15 secondary), heart circle on the right.
queue.list_title: 'Up Next' or the existing wording as a 22 pt bold SectionHeader.
queue.rows: SongRow style, 48 pt artwork. Current song: accent title + graphic_eq overlay and NO remove button (as today). Other rows keep the X as a small tertiary icon. Tap to jump stays as is.
queue.empty: Existing 'The queue is empty.' message in EmptyState style.

loop_editor_sheet.container: Modal bottom sheet, surface #1C1C1E, top radius 28, grabber, 20 pt margins, still scrollable.
loop_editor_sheet.title: 'Custom loop' 22 pt bold.
loop_editor_sheet.mode_selector: Same three options (Off / Finite / Infinite) as a pill segmented control: 40 pt tall, selected = accent fill with white text, unselected = chip_unselected.
loop_editor_sheet.waveform: Container radius 16, fill white 6-8%, slim rounded bars. Region highlight in accent. Keep the green/red handles, flags and time labels already working. Playhead white.
loop_editor_sheet.time_fields: Filled fields (white 8%), radius 12, no outline until focused (accent outline). The +/- buttons and 'Use current' become 44 pt glass circles / a small glass pill.
loop_editor_sheet.buttons: Preview = SecondaryButton (play/stop icon, label 'Preview' / 'Stop preview'). Save = full-width accent PrimaryButton. Cancel = plain text button in secondary color.
loop_editor_sheet.errors: Red (destructive) 13 pt text under the fields, as today.

dynamic_artwork_background.goal: Now Playing and Queue backgrounds take a dark tint from the current artwork, like Apple Music.
dynamic_artwork_background.no_package_method: Load the artwork file with ResizeImage/Image.file to about 16 x 16, read pixels via dart:ui (toByteData rawRgba), average them (skip near-black/near-white), convert to HSL, clamp saturation to <= 0.45 and lightness to 0.20-0.28 for the top color, and ~0.10-0.14 for the bottom color. Cache the result per song id in memory. Animate color changes with TweenAnimationBuilder (400 ms).
dynamic_artwork_background.fallback: No artwork or any error -> now_playing_fallback_gradient. Never let a color failure break the screen.
dynamic_artwork_background.package_note: palette_generator would be easier but is a NEW package: ASK THE OWNER FIRST. Default to the no-package method.

must_have: Single theme file (colors, text styles, radii) applied in main.dart; black background, accent, flat app bars
Library: large title, search field, pill chips, SongRow restyle, bottom padding for the floating player
Now Playing: gradient background, artwork + shadow, title row with heart, new seek bar, bare transport glyphs, loop status capsule, bottom row with Loop and Queue
Loop editor sheet restyle (keeping Keys and behavior)
nice_to_have_if_cheap: Remaining-time label instead of total (only if the owner wants it; PRD says total duration)
Animated equalizer on the current song row
skip: Apple Home / New / Radio tabs, catalog, streaming, profile avatar, For You carousels
A bottom tab bar (six library sections do not fit a 5-item iOS bar; chips are the chosen design)
Lyrics, AirPlay, volume slider, shuffle, explicit badges, crossfade
Accessibility pass (owner chose to skip it; just keep 44 pt touch targets where it costs nothing)
implementation_order: UI-1 Theme + tokens + GlassContainer + CircleIconButton (new files), apply theme in main.dart. Check the app still looks sane.
UI-2 Floating glass mini player + library bottom padding.
UI-3 Library screen: large title, search, pill chips, SongRow (and album/artist/playlist rows, detail screens).
UI-4 Now Playing: layout, gradient background (no-package color extraction), seek bar, transport, heart, loop status capsule, bottom row.
UI-6 Loop editor sheet + waveform container styling, dialogs, empty states, polish.
open_questions_for_agent_to_check: STATUS.md says Albums and Artists were built and then REMOVED on purpose, but the 6-3 and 6-5 notes describe them as existing tabs. Open library_screen.dart to see which tabs really exist and build the chip row from the real list.
Confirm the exact file and class names used above (they come from STATUS.md, which may be slightly out of date).
If a style choice here conflicts with something already working on the owner's phone, keep the working behavior and tell the owner.
